TS2532: `currentSession()` may be `undefined`
  at object-possibly-undefined.ts:8:23

    7 | 
  > 8 | export const userId = currentSession().user.id;
                              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    9 | 

  `currentSession()` can be `undefined` here — `currentSession()`'s return type includes it. TypeScript won't let you read from it until the code rules that out.

  Fix: Store it and check it once:
  const value = currentSession();
  if (value === undefined) {
    throw new Error("value is missing"); // or return a fallback
  }
  export const userId = value.user.id;
  Or, when a missing value may flow on as `undefined`:
  export const userId = currentSession()?.user.id;

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS2532 [ERROR]: Object is possibly 'undefined'.
  │ export const userId = currentSession().user.id;
  │                       ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  │     at file:///app/object-possibly-undefined.ts:8:23

error: Type checking failed.
